column1: # Alcove OS-layer package attribution: the relay image
# Every dpkg package in the relay image, with its version, the source package
# and source version it was built from, and its homepage. Debian packages
# declare no single licence string, so this list has no licence column: each
# package ships its licence text in /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright.
# Produced by a host run of dpkg-query, not by
# or check this file, so a base move leaves it stale until it is re-measured.
# queried: 2026-10-04 at linux/arm64; the amd64 package set is unmeasured
# source/source_version: the dpkg Source field split; an empty Source means source = package, and no version there means the binary version
